summary: Turkish nominal predication uses copular/person morphology rather than a single independent present-tense be; var/yok handle core existence and absence.

semantic_map.SEM.IDENTITY_EQUIVALENCE: nominal predicate + copular/person morphology; 3sg present often has no overt copular segment
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: state predicate + copular/person morphology; olmak in many lexical/non-present constructions
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: result-state predicate or olmak-based construction according to lexical pattern
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: possessive NP + var/yok is a core existence-style possession strategy
